program_overview.title: Kotlin and Android Masterclass
program_overview.tagline: The modern Android stack, learned in its native language: Kotlin to real depth, then apps built the way Google builds them, with Jetpack Compose.
program_overview.description:
Android runs on Kotlin now, and the modern stack, Compose for UI, coroutines for concurrency, is genuinely pleasant when learned in order. This live online masterclass does exactly that: Kotlin as a language first, null-safety, functional style, coroutines and flows understood properly, then Android development the modern way: Jetpack Compose interfaces, architecture that survives rotation and growth, data with Room, networking, and the production habits, testing, releases, honest store literacy, that separate app builders from tutorial followers. A finale month ships a capstone app and sits the final exam.

The pace is honest: ten teaching months at two live classes a week plus four to six hours of practice, with two more in hand. Problem sets, monthly mixed reviews, phase exams, and a final exam that decides the certificate with a free retest. Real Kotlin, real apps, depth over dopamine.
what_makes_this_different: Kotlin learned as a language, not as Android syntax: coroutines and flows understood before they are needed
Compose-first: the UI toolkit Google actually recommends, not legacy XML nostalgia
Architecture that survives: state, lifecycles and structure taught as the core Android skill they are
Store literacy told straight: what publishing takes, without fake promises
An honest 10-month arc with 2 months in hand
Real assessment: weekly problem sets, monthly mixed reviews, phase exams and a final exam with a free retest

faqs.question: What does this Kotlin and Android course cover?
faqs.answer: Kotlin as a real language first, null-safety, functional style, coroutines and flows, then modern Android: Jetpack Compose UI, architecture that survives rotation and growth, Room data, networking, testing and honest store literacy, ending with a store-grade capstone app and the final exam. Compose-first throughout: the stack Google actually recommends in 2026.

faqs.question: How long does it take to learn Kotlin and Android properly?
faqs.answer: Ten months of teaching at 2 live classes a week plus 4 to 6 hours of practice, with two more months in hand for learners who need them. The three teaching phases build the language and its real-world domain; the finale month ships a capstone and sits the final exam.

faqs.question: How am I assessed? Is the certificate just for attending?
faqs.answer: No. Problem sets follow every class with written feedback, monthly reviews deliberately mix new material with earlier topics, each phase ends with a cumulative exam, and the course ends with a final exam: a practical build plus written questions from the whole syllabus. Passing earns the certificate; falling short earns focused revision and a free retest.

faqs.question: Do I need to know Java first?
faqs.answer: No: Kotlin is taught from zero and is the better first language for Android today. Java interop is explained where it matters (older codebases), but modern Android development, and this course, runs Kotlin-first with Compose.

faqs.question: Will my app actually go on the Play Store?
faqs.answer: The course builds to store-grade discipline and walks the release process honestly: developer account costs, review rules, testing tracks. Publishing itself is your call and your account; what the course guarantees is an app and a release checklist that are genuinely ready for it.

faqs.question: What are the fees?
faqs.answer: Group classes are ₹1,499 per month, with 2 live classes a week in batches capped at 10 learners. A mini batch of 3-4 learners is ₹2,999 per month, and personal 1-on-1 classes are ₹4,999 per month. International learners pay a price set for their own country, shown on this page in their local currency.

faqs.question: Can I try a class before enrolling?
faqs.answer: Yes, a free demo class with no commitment: book at learn.modernagecoders.com/contact or message us on WhatsApp at +91 91233 66161.

faqs.question: Are classes live or recorded?
faqs.answer: Live, always: small groups with a real instructor reading your actual code, never pre-recorded videos.
